statements.status_notes: CVE-2018-18064: cairo through 1.15.14 has an out-of-bounds stack write when WebKitGTK renders a crafted document, from the interaction between generate() and render_rows() in cairo-rectangular-scan-converter.c and _cairo_image_spans_and_zero() in cairo-image-compositor.c. The upstream report (https://gitlab.freedesktop.org/cairo/cairo/-/issues/341) is still open, with no fix commit or fixed release, and Debian lists cairo as unfixed in every release, rated unimportant (https://security-tracker.debian.org/tracker/CVE-2018-18064, Debian bug 916083). This owner currently publishes one build, a rebuild of Debian trixie's cairo 1.18.4-1, as libcairo2, libcairo-gobject2, libcairo-script-interpreter2, libcairo2-dev and libcairo2-doc, plus dbgsym packages for libcairo2, libcairo-gobject2 and libcairo-script-interpreter2, for amd64 and arm64. The decompressed libcairo2 debug symbols for both architectures still name _cairo_image_spans_and_zero, render_rows and cairo-rectangular-scan-converter.c, so the code the report points at is present. Pending: an upstream fix, or upstream analysis showing the report does not reproduce on cairo 1.18; until either exists this owner stays under investigation.
